name: jay-claude-mod
description: Claude Code mods (function-hook plugins) for safer AWS work and a nicer chat.

plugins.name: client-guard
plugins.description: Asks you before any AWS write in a client account, enforces --region in personal projects, keeps CLAUDE.md hand-curated, and shows the AWS context above the prompt.

plugins.name: chat-timestamps
plugins.description: Shows when each message was sent, like a messaging app.

plugins.name: evidence-meter
plugins.description: Shows, under every answer, what Claude actually checked that turn: files read, commands and tests run, web pages fetched, and what failed.
